name: Valencia Nutrition Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2013, Valencia Nutrition Ltd is in the business of developing, manufacturing, sales & distribution of nutraceutical products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
VNL is a BSE Start Up Listed Corporate Company since January 2020. It is an applied biotechnology company focused on research, developing & marketing Ready to Drink nutraceuticals, Ready-to-Mix nutraceuticals (Ease Out Sachets) viz. AL Cans, Sachets, PET bottles, PET Cans, Tetra Pack, and Refreshment Mints etc. to prevent or manage lifestyle related diseases

cons: Stock is trading at 3.29 times its book value
Company has high debtors of 279 days.
Working capital days have increased from 385 days to 734 days
